title: Discrimination of seizure topographical images utilizing transfer learning approaches
title_zh: 利用迁移学习方法区分癫痫发作拓扑图像
abstract: Abstract Epilepsy is one of the most common neonatal neurological disorders, causing significant nervous system dysfunction. Early detection of seizures is critical for timely clinical intervention and reducing long-term neurological consequences. This study proposes an automated framework utilizing deep transfer learning architectures to classify neonatal seizures using topographic brainpower maps extracted from EEG signals. We utilized a publicly accessible dataset comprising recordings from 79 newborns, analyzed across three temporal window scenarios (1, 5, and 8 s). Three deep transfer learning models, GoogLeNet, ResNet-18, and ShuffleNet, were rigorously evaluated. While initial results approached the optimal accuracy across all temporal windows, a more rigorous subject-wise protocol was implemented to ensure clinical generalizability, where the models were tested on entirely unseen patients. Under this strict validation, ResNet-18 emerged as the superior architecture, achieving a remarkable peak subject-wise accuracy of 97.1% in the 8-second window scenario. Our findings confirm that the proposed framework is highly robust against inter-patient variability, representing a reliable and methodologically sound strategy for automated neonatal intensive care monitoring.
abstract_zh: 摘要 产前癫痫是最常见的新生儿神经系统疾病之一，导致显著的神经功能障碍。早期检测癫痫发作对于及时临床干预和降低长期神经后果至关重要。本研究提出了一种自动化框架，利用深度迁移学习架构对从脑电信号提取的拓扑脑电图进行新生儿癫痫发作分类。我们使用了一个公开可获取的数据集，包含79名新生儿的记录，并在三种时间窗口（1、5和8秒）下进行分析。对三种深度迁移学习模型——GoogLeNet、ResNet-18和ShuffleNet——进行了严格评估。初步结果在所有时间窗口中接近最佳准确率，但随后采用更严格的个体级验证协议，以确保临床可推广性，即在完全未见过的患者上测试模型。在此严格验证下，ResNet-18成为最优架构，在8秒窗口情景下实现了高达97.1%的个体级最高准确率。我们的发现表明，所提出的框架对患者间变异具有高度鲁棒性，代表了一种可靠且方法学上可靠的自动化新生儿重症监护策略。
